title: Build Tetris using React Native and Expo
description: Build the classic block-stacking game for mobile with Expo and TypeScript: a 10x20 board, all 7 tetrominoes with rotation, a gravity-driven game loop, touch controls, line-clearing, scoring, and a fair 7-bag next-piece queue.

lessons.title: The Board and the Grid

quiz.title: The Board and the Grid Quiz

questions.prompt: Why does createEmptyBoard() use Array.from() instead of Array(BOARD_HEIGHT).fill(Array(BOARD_WIDTH).fill(0))?
options: Array.from() is faster to type
fill() would make every row the same array reference, so mutating one row would mutate all of them
Array.from() is required by React Native
There's no real difference
questions.answer: fill() would make every row the same array reference, so mutating one row would mutate all of them

questions.prompt: In the board array, a cell value of 0 means that cell is empty.

lessons.title: The Game Loop: Gravity and Collision

questions.prompt: Why does hasCollision() check a hypothetical (row, col) instead of only the piece's current position?

To make the board render faster

questions.prompt: Why does tryMove() use the updater form setPiece((current) => ...) instead of reading piece directly?
options: It's required syntax in React Native specifically

lessons.title: Scoring, Levels, and Game Over

questions.prompt: Why is clearing 4 lines at once (800 points) worth more than 4x a single line clear (4 x 100 = 400)?
options: It is a bug in the scoring formula
It's a deliberate design choice that rewards setting up multi-line clears over clearing one line at a time
Four-line clears take longer to compute
There is no difference, LINE_SCORES is linear
questions.answer: It's a deliberate design choice that rewards setting up multi-line clears over clearing one line at a time

lessons.title: Next Piece Preview and the 7-Bag

questions.prompt: What problem does the 7-bag randomizer solve compared to plain Math.random() piece selection?

questions.answer: It guarantees every shape appears exactly once every 7 pieces, avoiding unfair streaks or long droughts
